title: Atlas census, as of the Alpha release
conclusion: At the Alpha release, the atlas held 7,040 studies, 47,702 samples and 228.0M cells. The median sample used 10% of its SRA reads: 89% of samples hit the 30M-read cap, and 37% had more than one run, of which only the first was used. These totals will be regenerated after the catalog load.

caveats: Totals are as of the Alpha release and will be regenerated after the catalog load.
Mouse samples had not been screened for wrong-strand counting when this census ran.
Cell counts are Singlet's knee-filter calls on reads capped at the first 30M of the first SRA run; they undercount against Cell Ranger and EmptyDrops.
Alpha matrices come from three builds of the atlas engine; all predate the molecule-count fix.
